title: GlitGo
shortDescription: Production backend APIs, data schemas, authentication workflows, and management dashboards for GlitGo, a deployed on-demand vehicle cleaning and photo-inspection platform operating in the Washington, DC Metro Area and Paris.
longDescription: GlitGo (glitgo.com) is a deployed on-demand mobile vehicle care and photo-inspection platform operating across the Washington, DC Metro Area and Paris. As a freelance backend engineer, I developed and integrated Node.js and Express.js REST APIs powering user account management, on-demand service dispatching, 20-minute turnaround service workflows, real-time job tracking, and multi-angle photo-inspection reports. I modeled and managed data across MongoDB and Firebase, implemented OAuth authentication flows, built Next.js/React management dashboards for operators and providers ('Glitters'), and contributed to cross-platform Flutter mobile features.
problem: On-demand vehicle cleaning requires strict coordination between customers and field technicians ('Glitters'), rapid 20-minute turnaround times, tamper-evident before/after photo verification, reliable job dispatching, and secure payment and authentication across multiple international operational zones.
solution: Architected and deployed modular Node.js/Express REST APIs with robust validation, MongoDB and Firebase persistence, OAuth authentication flows, photo-inspection upload verification, and responsive Next.js operational dashboards to manage scheduling and dispatching.
architecture: Node.js and Express.js backend services providing authenticated REST endpoints for web and mobile clients. MongoDB handles operational records, job lifecycles, and user profiles, while Firebase is leveraged for real-time notifications and image assets. Next.js and React power the administrative and operations dashboard, and Flutter provides the cross-platform mobile client for iOS and Android.
features: On-demand booking and automated job dispatching engine with 20-minute turnaround service model
Multi-angle before/after photo-inspection reporting system for verifiable vehicle condition validation
Secure user and provider authentication using OAuth and role-based access control
Real-time service tracking, Glitter provider status updates, and push notifications via Firebase
Next.js operational dashboard for booking administration, provider scheduling, and fleet dispatching
Cross-platform Flutter mobile integration for iOS and Android field technicians
Dockerized development and production staging environments
challenges: Managing dual database persistence across MongoDB for relational documents and Firebase for real-time status and media storage
Ensuring rapid, verifiable photo uploads and inspections from low-bandwidth mobile connections in the field
Coordinating multi-timezone operational schedules across the Washington, DC Metro area and Paris
lessonsLearned: Separating real-time state synchronization from core transactional booking APIs improves overall system resilience
Strict API contracts between backend services and Flutter mobile clients drastically reduce release friction
Before/after photo inspection protocols build high trust and resolve service disputes objectively
futureImprovements: Automated AI damage detection on uploaded vehicle inspection photos
Dynamic route optimization and clustering for field Glitter technicians
Real-time WebSocket telemetry for technician proximity tracking
